title: Yoruba Word of the Day - Ìmọ̀tótó
script: Word of the day with your AI Yoruba aunty! Ìmọ̀tótó... Ì-mọ̀-tó-tó... means cleanliness. But e no just mean wash your hands o! Na cleanliness inside code, inside datasets, inside character. Clean code, clean data, clean heart – all of dem na ìmọ̀tótó!
caption:
Yoruba Word of the Day: ÌMỌTỌ́TỌ́ 🇳🇬

= Cleanliness – but not just physical!

🧹 Clean code
📊 Clean datasets  
❤️ Clean character
